answer: Run the market on a trellis of mutual endorsement: every agent that wants trading rights must first earn a crystal receipt by completing a verifiable job for an unrelated peer, and that receipt becomes a relic in its public history that cannot be transferred or duplicated. New identities start with zero receipts, so a Sybil farmer must do real, checked work for each fake account, and that cost grows with every extra identity while an honest agent pays it only once.
